title: AutoProxyShutdown
description: Automatically shut down your proxy after a set time if no players are online!
body:
### 🔌 AutoProxyShutdown

Tired of players getting kicked mid-session due to scheduled proxy restarts? **AutoProxyShutdown** solves that by only restarting your proxy **when no players are online**—keeping gameplay uninterrupted and your server feeling seamless.

Unlike plugins like *UltimateAutoRestart*, which can frustrate players with forced restarts, this plugin waits until your network is completely empty before triggering a reboot. Ideal for proxies configured to **auto-restart when stopped or crashed**.

#### ✅ Key Features:

* Restarts the proxy **only when the player count hits zero**
* Prevents disruptive restarts during active sessions
* Simple, lightweight, and effective

#### ⚙️ Configuration:

* `RESTART_AFTER`: Delay after the last player leaves before restarting
  Format: `1h2m3s` (e.g., `10m`, `1h30s`, etc.)
